assumptions.reason: AccountAndChargeName is the most common subscription lookup type.
Stop processing events where no subscription match is found.
Only match active or cancelled subscriptions; exclude other statuses.
Include all rate plan charge segments by default, not just those active on the event date.
Include all charge types unless the meter only processes usage charges.

blockers.message: SUBSCRIPTION_LOOKUP accountNumberField is required. Which event field contains the account number?
SUBSCRIPTION_LOOKUP chargeNameField is required for AccountAndChargeName lookup. Which event field contains the charge name?
SUBSCRIPTION_LOOKUP subscriptionIdField is required for SubscriptionId lookup. Which event field contains the subscription ID?
SUBSCRIPTION_LOOKUP eventTimeField is required when includeSegmentsActiveOnDateOnly is true. Which event field contains the date to use for segment filtering?
